stem: Meera wants to find the density of a steel spoon she uses at home. She measures the mass of the spoon as 78 g and finds that it displaces 10 cm³ of water when fully immersed. Which calculation gives the correct density of the spoon?

options.text: 78 g, since the mass alone tells us the density

teacher.key_rationale: Density = mass ÷ volume = 78 g ÷ 10 cm³ = 7.8 g/cm³. Option A traps students who multiply mass by volume; C inverts the division; D treats mass alone as density, dropping the required condition that both mass and volume must be used.
